ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity white/cream to 30% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white segments occupy the central 75% of both lobes. A dominant black pigmentation swath extends from the peduncle through the median notch. Secondary black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edges and terminal tips. Yellowish-brown staining is localized in the lower-inner quadrants of the white segments.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate 55-degree internal pixel angle and significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge. The right lobe exhibits higher-amplitude peaks and deeper valleys compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges sweeping upward toward distal tips, with a distinct concavity on the trailing edge approaching the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, dark vertical rake mark is located on the left lobe approximately 40% of the distance from the notch to the tip. Multiple smaller linear pixel disruptions are visible near the tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct vertical linear scar on the interior of the left lobe; multiple surface scratches on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown bio-staining concentrated on the inner-half of both white ventral surfaces.
